text: {"assertions":["A blank render bug in ui/components/DataTable.tsx only manifested for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The bug appeared as an empty tbody element with no console error.","The root cause was a naive datetime being compared against a timezone-aware datetime.","The fix involved making every boundary datetime timezone-aware at the edge of the system.","The fix was implemented in PR #4145 on the fix/blank-render-1 branch.","The bug could be reproduced by opening the data table with a saved column layout.","The backlog cleared 8 minutes after the fix was deployed."]}
